messages.subject: Update Action button value
parts:
Hi, 
I am working on an app where I need to update the Action Button. I don't know how to update. Please help me.

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Update Action button value
parts:
actionButton can not be assigned value, it's read-only. 
Instead of using action button, you may try use reactiveValues.
